notes.content: Complete with a minimum GPA of 2.50 and a grade of C (2.0) or better: RWS 100 , RWS 200 ; COMM 103 ; ECL 220 or C LT 270A or C LT 270B; JMS 200 ; HUM 140 ; LING 101 ; six units from ENGL 250A and ENGL 250B or ENGL 260A and ENGL 260B; ECL 280 . These courses cannot be taken for credit/no credit (Cr/NC); Have a cumulative GPA of 2.40 or better.

1. Complete with a minimum GPA of 2.50 and a grade of C (2.0) or better: RWS 100, RWS 200; COMM 103; ECL 220 or C LT 270A or C LT 270B; JMS 200; HUM 140; LING 101; six units from ENGL 250A and ENGL 250B or ENGL 260A and ENGL 260B; ECL 280. These courses cannot be taken for credit/no credit (Cr/NC);
